subject: How to create a specific table//Equiry regarding creation of a new function?

messages.author: 08694dfaa1161c8d
messages.subject: How to create a specific table//Equiry regarding creation of a new function?
parts:
Hi, 

I'm an Undergraduate Psychology student using the tinyLPA package for my Honours Thesis. I would like to ask if it's possible to generate a diagram or statistics of this sort after the LPA is conducted. 


These diagrams show the probability of an assigned group in the other groups, as taken from McLaughlin, T. W., Snyder, P. A., & Algina, J. (2015). Characterizing early childhood disabilities in a nationally representative sample using functional profiles. Exceptional Children, 81(4), 471-488. I understand that this previous photo is taken from research which utilised LCA, but I was wondering if a similar table can be created using the data generated.

thank you for your time and patience.

messages.author: 3cfaef29dbc536f8
messages.subject: Re: How to create a specific table//Equiry regarding creation of a new function?
parts:
Hi, thank you for your question. This is very interesting to see. My colleagues and I have created similar plots before. Yes, it is possible to create these. If you are still looking to, we can try to point you in the right direction. Can you tell us whether you are using mclust (the default) or MPlus (the commercial software tidyLPA also provides an interface to)?

Best,
Josh

parts:
Hi Dr Josh,

Thank you for your reply, really appreciate it! Yes, I'm currently using mclust (the default) and I have 4 profiles using model 6. I'm still slightly confused with regard to how to choose an appropriate model, but I've decided on model 6 because the 3 indicators that I'm using have correlations of 0.342, 0.374 and 0.602.

Could you recommend resources which I can read to understand LPA better? 

Thank you so much!

Warmest regards,
Stephanie
